enriched_activities.activity: Working a rotating night shift as an aged-care support worker at a residential aged-care facility, assisting residents with personal care, repositioning, hydration and overnight observation, and writing up detailed handover notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the corridor of the aged-care facility. Push the medication and supplies trolley. Enter resident room. Turn on the room light. Greet the resident by name. Bend over the bed. Place hands under the resident's shoulders and hips. Reposition the resident onto their side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Pick up the water cup from the bedside table. Hold the cup to the resident's mouth. Return the cup to the table. Press the call button to test it. Turn off the room light. Walk to the next resident room. Repeat the repositioning and hydration checks. Sit at the nurse's station desk. Open the handover logbook. Write the time, resident name, care given and observations in the notes. Close the logbook. Hand the logbook to the incoming staff member. Say 'Resident in room 4 needs repositioning every two hours.' Pick up his bag. Walk out of the facility.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, sitting quietly with earplugs in and reading the shift handover notes on his phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the facility to the train station. Insert earplugs into both ears. Tap the transport card on the reader at the gate. Walk to the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Board the train. Sit down on a seat by the window. Take the phone out of the pocket. Unlock the phone. Open the handover notes file. Scroll down through the notes. Read the notes. Lock the phone. Put the phone back in the pocket. Stand up at the stop. Walk off the train. Walk to the bus stop. Board the bus. Tap the transport card. Sit down. Take the phone out again. Re-read the handover notes. Lock the phone. Put the phone away. Stand up. Walk off the bus. Walk to the apartment building. Unlock the front door. Walk inside.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light post-shift breakfast of wholegrain toast and a pot of tea using the kettle and toaster, then rinsing and stacking his dishes quietly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of wholegrain bread. Place the slices in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a teabag. Drop the teabag into the teapot. Open the fridge. Take out the milk. Close the fridge. Pour hot water from the kettle into the teapot. Put the kettle down. Wait for the toaster to pop. Take the toast out of the toaster. Place the toast on a plate. Spread margarine on the toast with a knife. Pour tea into a cup. Add milk to the cup. Carry the plate and cup to the table. Sit down. Eat the toast. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate, cup and knife to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and cup. Turn off the tap. Place the dishes on the drying rack. Wipe the bench with a cloth. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower with the water heater, washing up after the night shift and changing into clean sleep clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature with the mixer handle. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Lather the body. Rinse off. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Apply to the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Take the towel off the hook. Dry the body with the towel. Dry the hair. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the clean sleep clothes from the bag. Put on the sleep shirt. Put on the sleep shorts. Pick up the dirty work clothes. Place the dirty clothes in the laundry basket. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift with the fan on low and the light off, phone set to silent, needing quiet for daytime recovery
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Pull the curtains closed. Turn off the bedroom light. Pick up the phone. Press the silent mode button. Place the phone face down on the bedside table. Walk to the fan. Press the fan power button. Press the speed button to set the fan to low. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the side. Close the eyes. Lie still. Turn onto the other side. Adjust the pillow. Remain lying on the bed with eyes closed. Turn onto the back. Remain lying on the bed with eyes closed. Continue sleeping. Continue sleeping. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking slowly, checking text messages on his phone and reviewing the written reminders and checklist that keep his routine on track
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Turn the head towards the bedside table. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs over the edge of the bed. Put the feet on the floor. Reach out and pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the power button. Unlock the phone. Open the messages app. Scroll through the text messages. Type a short reply. Send the reply. Lock the phone. Put the phone down on the bedside table. Pick up the paper checklist from the desk. Read the checklist items. Pick up the pen. Tick off the completed items. Put the pen down. Place the checklist back on the desk. Stand up from the bed. Open the bedroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a light flexitarian lunch of leftover rice, vegetables and chickpeas reheated in the microwave with a cup of tea, then washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the fridge. Take out the container of leftover rice, vegetables and chickpeas. Close the fridge. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the reheat button. Press start. Fill the kettle with water. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a teabag. Drop the teabag into a cup. Pour hot water into the cup. Put the kettle down. Open the microwave when it beeps. Take out the container. Carry the container and cup to the table. Sit down. Eat the rice, vegetables and chickpeas with a fork. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the container, fork and cup to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the container, fork and cup. Turn off the tap. Place the items on the drying rack. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying at his desk under the desk lamp, reading assigned Master of Social Work coursework on the computer and monitor and writing structured summary notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Press the computer power button. Wait for the computer to start. Open the monitor power button. Move the mouse. Open the browser. Log into the university learning portal. Open the assigned coursework reading. Scroll down the page. Read the reading. Open the note-taking document. Type the heading of the reading. Type summary notes in bullet points. Switch back to the reading. Scroll to the next section. Read the section. Switch to the notes document. Type further summary notes. Save the document with Ctrl+S. Look at the clock on the monitor. Close the learning portal tab. Close the notes document.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating an early dinner of rice in the rice cooker with stir-fried vegetables and tofu on the induction cooker, then washing up and wiping the bench
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the cupboard. Take out the rice container. Measure rice into the rice cooker inner pot. Rinse the rice at the tap. Add water to the pot. Place the pot into the rice cooker. Close the rice cooker lid. Press the cook button. Open the fridge. Take out the vegetables and tofu. Close the fridge. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Cut the tofu into cubes. Turn on the range hood. Press the induction cooker power button. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the tofu cubes. Stir the tofu with a spatula. Add the vegetables. Stir the vegetables. Turn off the induction cooker. Take a bowl from the cupboard. Scoop rice from the rice cooker into the bowl. Add the tofu and vegetables to the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down. Eat the rice, tofu and vegetables with chopsticks. Stand up. Carry the bowl, chopsticks and pan to the sink. Turn on the tap. Wash the bowl, chopsticks, pan, knife and cutting board. Turn off the tap. Place the items on the drying rack. Wipe the bench with a cloth. Turn off the range hood. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking university unit announcements on the computer, replying to messages by text only and reviewing his upcoming shift roster to confirm dates in advance
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Move the mouse to wake the computer. Open the browser. Log into the university portal. Open the unit announcements page. Scroll through the announcements. Read each announcement. Close the announcements page. Open the messages app on the phone. Read the incoming messages. Type replies by text. Send each reply. Put the phone down. Open the shift roster page on the computer. Scroll through the roster. Read the dates and shift times. Open the calendar document. Type the confirmed dates into the calendar. Save the calendar document. Close the browser. Stand up from the chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing his weekly laundry, sorting light and dark items into the washing machine, transferring them to the clothes dryer and running the dehumidifier
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the laundry basket. Carry it to the washing machine. Open the washing machine door. Take out the light-coloured clothes. Place the light-coloured clothes into the machine. Take out the dark-coloured clothes. Place the dark-coloured clothes aside. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button. Turn the programme dial to the wash cycle. Press the start button. Wait for the cycle to finish. Open the washing machine door. Take out the wet clothes. Place the wet clothes into the clothes dryer. Close the clothes dryer door. Press the dryer power button. Press start. Press the dehumidifier power button. Press the dehumidifier switch on. Wait for the dryer to finish. Open the clothes dryer door. Take out the dry clothes. Fold the clothes. Place the folded clothes into the basket. Turn off the dehumidifier. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Drafting part of a written social work assignment at his desk using the computer and monitor, following his detailed written plan step by step
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Move the mouse. Open the assignment document on the computer. Pick up the written plan from the desk. Read step one of the plan. Place the plan back on the desk. Type the opening paragraph. Read the paragraph on the monitor. Delete a sentence. Retype the sentence. Press Enter. Type the next paragraph. Copy a citation from the reference list document. Paste the citation into the assignment document. Type the reference in the reference list. Save the document with Ctrl+S. Look at the written plan. Read step two. Type the next section heading. Type the section content. Save the document again. Check the word count on the monitor.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea with the kettle, having a small evening snack and tidying the kitchen surfaces and drying rack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a teabag. Drop the teabag into a cup. Open the biscuit packet. Take out two biscuits. Place the biscuits on a small plate. Pour hot water into the cup. Put the kettle down. Pick up the cup and plate. Carry them to the table. Sit down. Drink the tea. Eat the biscuits. Stand up. Carry the cup and plate to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the cup and plate. Turn off the tap. Place them on the drying rack. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the kitchen bench. Wipe the table surface. Put the cloth down. Rearrange the items on the drying rack. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Updating his weekly cash budget notebook, checking bills are predictable for the week and writing tomorrow's to-do list and reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the drawer. Take out the cash budget notebook. Place the notebook on the desk. Open the notebook to the current week page. Pick up the pen. Write the date. Count the cash in the wallet. Write the cash amount in the notebook. Open the bills folder. Read each bill amount. Write the bill amounts in the notebook. Add up the totals on the calculator. Write the total in the notebook. Close the notebook. Open the to-do list notepad. Write tomorrow's tasks line by line. Write the reminder to check the shift roster. Tear off no pages, keep the notepad. Close the pen. Place the pen down. Place the notebook and notepad in the drawer. Close the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands. Pick up the soap. Lather the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Take the towel off the hook. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Turn on the tap. Rinse the mouth. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quiet wind-down with the light dimmed and the fan on, looking at the photo of his family dog in China and listening to calm audio before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Walk to the bed. Sit down on the bed. Reach to the bedside table lamp switch. Press the switch to dim the light. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Open the audio app. Select the calm audio track. Press play. Put the phone on the bedside table. Press the fan power button. Press the speed button to set the fan to low. Pick up the photo frame from the bedside table. Hold the photo of the family dog. Look at the photo. Place the photo frame back on the bedside table. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close the eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the room kept dark and quiet for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with eyes closed. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders. Turn onto the side. Adjust the pillow under the head. Keep the fan running on low. Keep the bedside lamp off. Keep the phone on the bedside table. Turn onto the other side. Remain lying on the bed with eyes closed. Continue sleeping. Continue sleeping. Continue sleeping. Continue sleeping.
